contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Book online in a few clicks, or give us a call.

items.a: At Palokestraat 146, 1700 Dilbeek, close to Anderlecht, Molenbeek-Saint-Jean and Berchem-Sainte-Agathe.

items.q: How do I book an appointment?
items.a: Online on the Book page, by phone on {phone} or on WhatsApp.

items.q: Can I cancel or move my appointment?
items.a: Yes, free of charge up to 24 hours before, by phone, email or WhatsApp. If you are more than 15 minutes late, the treatment may be shortened or rescheduled so that the following appointments stay on time.
On site, at the end of the treatment, in cash, by Bancontact or by bank card. Courses and gift vouchers are paid at purchase. Prices are shown in euros, VAT included.
Yes. A gift voucher covers a specific treatment or an amount, for 12 months.

items.q: How long does a treatment take?
items.a: It depends on the treatment: 20 or 30 minutes for an LED light session, 30 or 45 minutes for the Purity Ritual, 30 to 60 minutes for a massage, 60 minutes for maderotherapy. The length of each treatment is shown in the price list.

items.q: Do you offer courses of treatments?
items.a: Yes, for several treatments, for example 5 LED sessions for €110 or 5 maderotherapy sessions for €340. A course is personal to one client. Its validity is given at purchase.

items.q: What happens before a first technical treatment?
items.a: It starts with a consultation: an analysis of your skin, how the treatment works, the expected effects and the contraindications. A preliminary test may be done, and the treatment only takes place with your written consent. This applies for example to laser, radiofrequency, peels and the Micro-Pen.

items.q: I am pregnant, can I come?
items.a: Yes. The Gentle Mum Ritual is a massage designed for pregnancy. Always mention your pregnancy before a treatment: some treatments are not carried out during this period.

items.q: Can a minor have a treatment?
items.a: Yes, with the written consent of a parent, who attends the first appointment. Technical treatments are for adults only.

items.q: Should I expect any reaction after a treatment?
items.a: After some treatments, temporary redness or sensitivity is possible. Follow the advice given after the session, for example sun protection. If you notice an unusual reaction, contact us straight away.

items.q: Do you sell products for home use?
items.a: Yes, a selection of high-end beauty products to extend your treatments at home.

charbon.title: Carbon Peel Bubble Signature
charbon.metaTitle: Carbon Peel Bubble Signature, radiance - My Bubble Beauty
charbon.description: Carbon Peel Bubble Signature: a treatment for radiance, purity and skin quality on the face, neck and décolleté. À la carte options, benefits and prices.
charbon.articleHtml:
Carbon Peel Bubble Signature is a treatment for radiance, purity and skin quality. It combines a carbon mask with an aesthetic laser to purify the skin, reduce shine and revive the radiance of your complexion. Here is how a session goes:

Initial consultation

Before the first session, we look at your skin, talk about what you would like and choose the area to treat together.

Before the treatment, we check with you for any contraindications, such as pregnancy, ongoing medical treatment or damaged skin.

Cleansing the skin

Make-up is removed and the skin is cleansed of impurities and excess sebum. It must be clean and dry before the rest of the treatment.

Applying the carbon mask

A thin layer of carbon cream is spread evenly over the area, then left to dry for a few minutes.

The laser

You wear protective glasses throughout this step. The laser is moved gently over the area. Its light is absorbed by the carbon particles, which are removed from the surface of the skin. You may feel slight warmth or small tingles.

Cleansing and soothing

The carbon residue is removed. A soothing treatment followed by sun protection ends the session.

The areas treated

  • Full face (30 to 45 min). A purifying, revitalising treatment that aims to improve the look of pores, reduce shine and revive the radiance of your complexion.
  • Face + neck (45 to 60 min). A targeted treatment to refine the look of the skin’s texture and even out your complexion.
  • Face + neck + décolleté (60 to 75 min). Our complete signature treatment, working on the look of the skin across all three areas for a brighter, more harmonious appearance.
  • Neck + décolleté (30 to 45 min). A dedicated treatment to improve the look and evenness of the skin on the neck and décolleté.

The benefits we aim for

Face. Less visible pores, clearer-looking skin, a brighter complexion, improved skin texture.

Neck. Better-looking skin, a more even tone, a more uniform appearance.

Décolleté. A finer-looking skin texture, a visibly more even tone, brighter-looking skin.

After the treatment

Slight redness may appear and usually fades within a few hours. Over the following days, protect your skin from the sun and avoid scrubs. The number of sessions and their frequency are set with you according to your skin and goals. Results vary from person to person.

figures.alt: Client wearing protective glasses during a Carbon Peel treatment

dents.title: Teeth Whitening
dents.description: Teeth whitening is a cosmetic treatment that aims to lighten the colour of the teeth and reduce stains. Procedure, precautions and prices.
dents.articleHtml:
Teeth whitening is a cosmetic treatment designed to brighten the colour of teeth, making them whiter and brighter. This treatment is commonly performed in aesthetic dentistry to enhance the appearance of a smile by reducing stains and discolourations on the teeth. Here is how teeth whitening works in aesthetics:

Initial Evaluation

Before the teeth whitening process begins, a dentist or aesthetic professional conducts an initial evaluation to determine whether the treatment is suitable for you. Some individuals may not qualify due to underlying dental issues.

Preparation

First, your teeth are cleaned to remove plaque and tartar, which could hinder the bleaching process.

Before the treatment, we check with you for any contraindications, such as pregnancy, ongoing medical treatment, sensitive teeth or irritated gums.

Whitening Options

At-Home Whitening: The dentist may provide an at-home whitening kit with custom-made trays and a bleaching gel containing a low concentration of hydrogen peroxide or carbamide peroxide. You fill the trays with the gel and wear them for a specified period daily over a few weeks. This is a gradual process.

In-Office Whitening: This method is also known as professional in-chair bleaching. The dentist applies a more concentrated bleaching gel to your teeth and then uses a special light or a laser to activate the gel. This process is usually faster and may provide immediate results.

Aftercare

After whitening, you may be advised to avoid certain potentially staining foods and beverages (such as coffee, tea, and red wine) for a while to maintain the results. Good oral care, including regular brushing and flossing, is also essential.

Mechanism of Teeth Whitening

The fundamental principle of teeth whitening is based on the use of products containing hydrogen peroxide or carbamide peroxide. These chemicals penetrate the tooth enamel and react with the molecules responsible for stains and discolourations, breaking them down to brighten the teeth's colour. However, it's important to note that teeth whitening is not permanent, and the results can vary from person to person, depending on various factors, including the type of tooth stains and dietary habits.

Pre-Treatment Advice

It is highly recommended to consult a dentist or an aesthetic dental professional before considering teeth whitening, as it may not be suitable for everyone, especially those with existing dental issues. Furthermore, teeth whitening should be performed under the supervision of a professional to help ensure the safety and effectiveness of the treatment.

figures.alt: Smile before and after teeth whitening

laserepilation.title: Laser hair removal
laserepilation.metaTitle: Laser hair removal in Dilbeek - My Bubble Beauty
laserepilation.description: Laser hair removal reduces hair growth over the long term, session after session, for smoother skin. How it works, treatment goals and prices by area.
laserepilation.articleHtml:
Laser hair removal is a technique that reduces hair growth over the long term, using concentrated light that targets the melanin in the hair.

The light energy is absorbed by the hair follicle and turned into heat, which destroys or damages the structures responsible for regrowth.

Session after session, hair growth gradually decreases: hairs usually become fewer, finer and less visible.

The treatment requires several sessions, as the laser works best on hairs in their growth phase.

Treatment goals

  • Reduce hair growth over the long term.
  • Lower hair density.
  • Slow down regrowth.
  • Get smoother skin.
  • Limit ingrown hairs and shaving irritation.
  • Ease the hassle of traditional hair removal.

Why choose laser

Laser reduces hair growth over the long term. Your skin stays smooth longer than after shaving or waxing.

Each treatment is tailored to your skin and hair. Session by session, regrowth decreases and so does irritation.

Before the treatment, we check with you for any contraindications, such as pregnancy, ongoing medical treatment or damaged skin.

epilation-cire.title: The art of soft skin
epilation-cire.metaTitle: Waxing in Dilbeek, chocolate or honey wax - My Bubble Beauty
epilation-cire.description: Waxing with chocolate or honey wax for face, body, legs and bikini line, plus packages. Precautions before your treatment and prices.
epilation-cire.articleHtml:
Treat your skin to a true moment of softness with our waxing treatments.

We use a quality wax, available in two indulgent textures: chocolate or honey. These waxes are selected for their comfort of application and their effectiveness, so hair is removed while your skin is left soft and cared for.

Every treatment is carried out with care, with respect for your skin and your sensitivity.

Precautions before your waxing

For waxing in the best conditions, please let us know about any particular sensitivity, known allergy, irritation or dermatological treatment.

Waxing is postponed in case of:

  • wounds or skin lesions;
  • burns or sunburn;
  • infection or significant irritation;
  • an allergic reaction on the area;
  • skin weakened by certain dermatological treatments, retinoids in particular.

After waxing, avoid sun exposure, intense heat, scrubs and irritating products for 24 to 48 hours.

The softness of your skin is our priority. Softness, right down to your skin.

mado.title: Maderotherapy
mado.metaTitle: Maderotherapy, Silhouette Ritual - My Bubble Beauty
mado.description: Maderotherapy is a deep, toning massage with wooden tools that works on the look of the skin. How it works, courses and prices.
mado.articleHtml:
Maderotherapy is a massage technique from Colombia. It uses wooden tools designed to work on the different areas of the body.

The movements are precise, rhythmic and repeated. They massage the tissues, stimulate local circulation and work on the look of the skin. It is popular for its toning effect and deep massage.

The benefits

  • Circulation. Supports local blood and lymph circulation.
  • Skin. Can make the skin look smoother.
  • Orange-peel skin. Skin that looks smoother.
  • Drainage. The movements help move surface fluids.
  • Tone. Brings a feeling of tone and lightness.
  • Relaxation. Feels like a deep massage.

Maderotherapy does not make you lose fat. It does not guarantee a lasting loss of centimetres. Results vary from person to person.

How it works

Before the first session, we do a short assessment. Together we choose the areas to work on: stomach, thighs, buttocks, hips or arms. The pressure is adapted to your sensitivity.

A session lasts 60 minutes, to work on several areas properly. In a course of 5 or 10 sessions, we leave enough time between sessions depending on how your skin reacts. We follow the progress with you.

Precautions

Too much pressure can cause pain or bruising. We do not treat an area with inflammation, a lesion or a vascular problem without medical advice. You fill in a questionnaire before the first session.

What you can expect

  • Legs that feel lighter.
  • A moment of relaxation and deep massage.
  • A possible temporary improvement in the look of orange-peel skin.
  • Skin that can look smoother after the massage.

figures.alt: Leg massage with a wooden maderotherapy roller

microneed.title: Micro-Pen
microneed.metaTitle: Micro-Pen, face and body treatments - My Bubble Beauty
microneed.description: Micro-Pen stimulates the skin’s natural renewal to work on its texture and radiance. Face and body treatments, precautions and prices.
microneed.articleHtml:
Micro-Pen is an aesthetic technique that uses fine micro-needles to stimulate the skin’s natural renewal mechanisms.

This treatment works on skin texture, improves radiance and helps the skin look smoother, more even and brighter.

Each protocol is tailored to your skin’s needs for personalised care.

Our face treatments: the Signature Collection

  • Signature Éclat, to revive the radiance of your complexion and even it out.
  • Signature Hydra, for visibly more hydrated, supple and plumper skin.
  • Signature Lift, to work on the look of fine lines and loss of firmness.
  • Signature Skin, to improve the look of skin texture and uneven areas.
  • Signature Pure, to work on the look of residual blemishes and enlarged pores.

Our body treatments

  • Signature Body (from 180 €). A targeted treatment for the look of stretch marks, depending on the area.
  • Signature Scar (from 190 €). A targeted treatment for the look of scars, after a skin assessment.

Body treatment prices depend on the size and type of the area treated.

Contraindications and precautions

Micro-Pen requires a prior skin assessment. Some situations may prevent the treatment or require it to be postponed:

  • Pregnancy and breastfeeding, as a precaution.
  • Herpes or an active skin infection.
  • Severe inflammatory acne.
  • Eczema, psoriasis or rosacea flaring on the area.
  • Wounds, burns or skin irritation.
  • A tendency to keloid scars.
  • Clotting disorders or anticoagulant medication.
  • Weakened immunity or uncontrolled diabetes.
  • Isotretinoin treatment, recent or ongoing.
  • Known allergy to the products or materials used.

If you are ill, under medical treatment or in any doubt, medical advice is needed before any treatment.

Results

Results vary from person to person. Several sessions may be needed. Micro-Pen does not guarantee that scars or stretch marks will disappear.

peeling.title: Superficial Peel
peeling.description: A superficial peel is a gentle exfoliating treatment that aims to improve skin texture and even out skin tone. Find out how it works and the price.
peeling.articleHtml:
A superficial peel is an aesthetic treatment aimed at improving skin texture, creating a more even tone, and reducing certain minor skin issues such as pigmentation, fine lines, and blemishes on acne-prone skin. This technique uses a mild chemical solution to exfoliate the top layer of the skin, with the aim of stimulating cell renewal and promoting smoother, more radiant skin. Here's how a superficial peel usually works:

Initial Consultation

Prior to a superficial peel, an aesthetic professional assesses the condition of your skin, discusses your specific concerns, and determines whether the peel is suitable for your skin type and needs. There are various types of chemical solutions for peels, and the choice depends on your skin type and the treatment's purpose.

Before the treatment, we check with you for any contraindications, such as pregnancy, ongoing medical treatment or damaged skin.

Skin Cleansing

Before applying the peel solution, the skin is carefully cleansed to remove dirt, makeup, and oils.

Application of the Peel Solution

Next, the aesthetic professional applies the peel solution to the skin, ensuring that the treated area is evenly covered. The solution may contain alpha hydroxy acids (AHAs), beta hydroxy acids (BHAs), or other mild exfoliating ingredients.

Contact Time

The peel solution remains on the skin for a short time determined by the professional, usually for several minutes. The duration depends on the solution's concentration and your skin's tolerance.

Neutralization

After the contact time has passed, the professional neutralizes the solution by rinsing it off or using a specific product to stop the chemical action.

Post-Peel Care

After the treatment, it's essential to follow the post-peel instructions provided by the aesthetic professional. This may include applying a moisturizing cream, using specific products, and avoiding sun exposure for some time, as the skin is often more sensitive after a peel.

Results

The results of a superficial peel are usually not immediately visible, as the skin needs time to renew itself. However, in the days and weeks following the treatment, the skin should appear brighter, more even, and smoother.

A superficial peel is considered a mild treatment and typically doesn't require extended recovery time. However, multiple sessions may be necessary to achieve the desired results, and it's essential to choose a qualified professional to minimize risks and optimize the benefits of the treatment. This treatment can be applied to various body parts, such as the face, neck, décolletage, and hands, depending on your needs.

photo.title: LED light therapy
photo.metaTitle: LED light therapy - My Bubble Beauty
photo.description: A gentle treatment with red or blue LED light, for dull, mature or blemish-prone skin. Rituals, courses and prices.
photo.articleHtml:
LED light therapy is a gentle treatment. It uses different colours of light to support the needs of the skin. It is popular for anti-ageing care, blemish-prone skin and skin with redness.

The colours of light

Red light, radiance and firmness. It supports anti-ageing care. It can improve the look of fine lines, skin texture and firmness.

Blue light, purity. It supports oily and acne-prone skin. It can help reduce blemishes.

Yellow light, radiance and soothing. It supports dull skin and can improve the look of redness.

Green light, even complexion. It supports uneven skin tone and can work on the look of dark spots.

The effects depend on the light, the power and the protocol. They are not the same for every colour or every skin. Results vary from person to person.

Our light rituals

  • Radiance & Youth (20 min): red light, for mature or dull skin.
  • Purity & Blemishes (20 min): blue light, for oily, blemish-prone skin.
  • Double Radiance (20 min): both lights, for skin with blemishes and signs of tiredness.
  • Signature Light (30 min): red light, blue light or both, chosen for your skin.

The courses

The Radiance course has 5 sessions and the Beauty course 10 sessions. The Signature course has 10 tailored 30-minute sessions. LED can also complete a facial in our combined packages.

Before the treatment, we check any contraindications with you, for example pregnancy, ongoing medical treatment or damaged skin.

figures.alt: Client's face under a red LED panel

plasma.title: The Plasma Pen / Micropen
plasma.metaTitle: The Plasma Pen / Micropen - My Bubble Beauty
plasma.description: The plasma pen / micropen is an aesthetic device that aims to improve the appearance of sagging skin, wrinkles, scars and pigmentation spots.
plasma.articleHtml:
The plasma pen / micropen is a relatively recent aesthetic treatment device used to improve the appearance of various skin concerns, including sagging skin, wrinkles, scars, stretch marks, and pigmentation spots. This device works by generating a plasma arc on the skin's surface, resulting in controlled micro-injuries. This is how the plasma pen typically works in aesthetics:

Basic Principle

The plasma pen uses electrical energy to create a thin, hot plasma arc at the tip of the pen. Plasma is ionized gas composed of charged particles, which means it contains ions and free electrons.

Application

The aesthetic professional uses the plasma pen to treat specific areas of the skin. When the pen's tip touches the skin, the plasma arc is directed onto the skin's surface, creating extremely small, burning micro-points on the skin while limiting the impact on the surrounding tissues.

Skin Tightening

The application of plasma can result in immediate skin tightening as the generated heat causes contraction of collagen fibres in the treated area. This can help reduce the appearance of sagging skin.

Formation of Scabs and Micro-Injuries

The micro-points created by the plasma pen also lead to the formation of scabs on the skin. In the days following the treatment, these scabs naturally fall off, revealing new skin underneath. During this recovery phase, the skin also produces additional collagen, which can improve skin texture and overall appearance.

Results

The results of the plasma pen can vary depending on the targeted skin concern and the depth at which the device is used. You may see improvements in the appearance of your skin over time as the effects of collagen become visible. However, multiple sessions may be needed to achieve optimal results.

The plasma pen is a treatment that works on the surface of the skin. You may feel slight tingling during the session. Small scabs may appear and fall off on their own within a few days. Results vary from person to person.

Before the treatment, we check with you for any contraindications, such as pregnancy, ongoing medical treatment or damaged skin.

The plasma pen should be used by trained and experienced aesthetic professionals, as improper use can lead to complications or scarring. As with any aesthetic treatment, it's recommended to consult with an aesthetic professional to discuss your specific needs and determine if the plasma pen is suitable for you.

A session lasts 30 or 60 minutes, depending on the number of areas.

Our massages help release tension. Our scrubs leave the skin soft.

Our relaxing massages

Bamboo & Balance Ritual: bamboo massage. A rhythmic, enveloping massage with bamboo sticks. It works on body tension, stimulates the tissues and leaves a pleasant feeling of lightness. 60 minutes.

Gold & Softness Ritual: argan oil massage. A delicate massage with argan oil, which nourishes the skin and wraps it in softness. Its flowing movements help you let go. 60 minutes.

Feather & Serenity Ritual: light-stroke massage. Slow, light and harmonious movements. A true invitation to relax, to calm body and mind. 45 minutes.

Gentle Mum Ritual: pregnancy massage. A moment for the mother-to-be. Gentle movements adapted to pregnancy, for relaxation and comfort. 60 minutes.

Our body scrubs

Lavender & Softness Ritual. A scrub delicately scented with lavender. It helps remove dead skin cells and leaves the skin soft and silky. 30 minutes.

Honey & Velvet Ritual. An indulgent scrub that pairs the softness of honey with a delicate ritual. The skin feels soft, supple and comfortable again. 30 minutes.

Our signature rituals

To make the moment last, we pair a scrub with a massage.

  • Awakening of the Senses. Lavender scrub and light-stroke massage.
  • Precious Softness. Honey scrub and argan oil massage.
  • Total Escape. Scrub of your choice and hot stone massage.

Before the treatment, we check any contraindications with you, for example ongoing medical treatment or damaged skin. During pregnancy, we offer you the Gentle Mum Ritual, designed for you.

brosse.title: Purity Ritual: the rotating brush
brosse.metaTitle: Purity Ritual, rotating brush facial - My Bubble Beauty
brosse.description: A cleansing and exfoliating facial with a rotating brush, for softer, brighter-looking skin. Benefits, skin types and prices.
brosse.articleHtml:
The Purity Ritual is a facial with a rotating brush. The brush gives a mechanical cleanse and a light exfoliation. It clears the skin of impurities and of the dead cells that build up on its surface.

The benefits

  • Removes dead cells from the surface.
  • Helps clear out impurities.
  • Visibly refines skin texture.
  • Leaves the skin softer and smoother.
  • Brings radiance to the complexion.
  • Prepares the skin for the next products.
  • Helps improve the look of rough areas.

Two options

The cleanse takes 30 minutes. The full treatment takes 45 minutes: cleanse, rotating brush, suitable mask and finishing cream. It can also be combined with LED light therapy.

Which skin types?

It suits normal, combination and thick skin, depending on how sensitive it is. We avoid it on very sensitive or irritated skin, and with marked couperose, inflammatory rosacea, eczema, lesions or significant inflammatory acne.

Before the treatment, we check any contraindications with you, for example pregnancy, ongoing medical treatment or damaged skin.

regard.articleHtml:
Brow and lash treatments, tailored to your face.

Brow reconstruction

A personalised treatment that reshapes and balances the line of your brows to suit the shape of your face. It includes restructuring and hair removal, for a balanced shape that suits every look.

Brow tint

Tinting deepens the natural colour of your brows, defines their line and gives more depth to your eyes. The shade is chosen to match your natural colour and the result you want.

Lash tint

This treatment darkens your natural lashes to make your eyes stand out, with a subtle mascara effect and no make-up. Ideal for enhancing your eyes every day.

Brow Lift

Brow Lift is a technique that tames the brow hairs and sets them upwards, for a fuller, lifted and structured look. It gives more harmonious brows and naturally open eyes.

Combined packages

For a harmonious result and beautifully enhanced eyes, combine our treatments.

Your eyes, our priority. Beauty lies in the details.

semi-permanent.title: The art of semi-permanent polish
semi-permanent.metaTitle: Semi-permanent polish, hands and feet - My Bubble Beauty
semi-permanent.description: Semi-permanent polish for hands and feet: intense colour, long-lasting shine and a neat finish. Services, contraindications and prices.
semi-permanent.articleHtml:
Semi-permanent polish gives an intense, glossy colour that lasts.

We apply it on hands and feet. The result stays natural.

Our services

Each service includes nail preparation, cuticle care, shaping and a neat finish.

Contraindications

To protect the health and beauty of your nails, semi-permanent polish cannot be applied in some situations:

  • Fungal or other nail infection.
  • Nails with inflammation or an injury.
  • Wounds, irritation or lesions around the nails.
  • Known allergy to ingredients in the products used, especially acrylates.
  • Badly damaged nails or an abnormality that needs medical advice.

If in doubt, the service will be postponed and medical advice may be recommended.
